name: startup
js: (async()=>{window.__pitchMapWait=(condition,label,timeout=120000)=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const begin=performance.now();const poll=()=>{try{if(condition())return resolve(true);if(performance.now()-begin>timeout)return reject(Error('Timed out: '+label));setTimeout(poll,100);}catch(error){reject(error);}};poll();});await window.__pitchMapWait(()=>window.__moondaTest&&window.__moonda?.progress?.done,'startup progress.done',150000);window.__moondaTest.setLanguage('en');const enter=document.querySelector('.start-enter');if(enter&&!enter.disabled)enter.click();document.querySelector('.moonda-tutorial-visible .moonda-tutorial-close')?.click();await window.__pitchMapWait(()=>!document.querySelector('.start-enter'),'start screen dismissal',10000);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));await window.__pitchMapWait(()=>{document.querySelector('.moonda-tutorial-visible .moonda-tutorial-close')?.click();return !document.querySelector('.moonda-tutorial-visible');},'tutorial dismissal',10000);return {done:window.__moonda.progress.done};})()

name: rockSeats
rockSeatAssertion
js: (()=>{const r=window.__pitchRockMetrics;if(!r?.passed)throw Error('Rock seat assertion failed; full metrics are in evals.rockSeats');return {passed:r.passed,nearSamples:r.near.samples,farSamples:r.far.samples};})()
